caption: Castel Sant'Elmo, Naples
composition: Hilltop volcanic-stone fortress overlooking the Bay of Naples and Vesuvius · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the rampart path the camera looks toward the volcanic-stone fortress of Castel Sant'Elmo crowning the hilltop on the right. The cobbled path leads up to the gate between the walls, while to the left the Bay of Naples and the city spread below with Vesuvius on the horizon. The 11:22 sun is bright in a clear blue sky.
